feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 599 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 40 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: BigQuery Query Cost Advisor — On-Demand vs Editions and Query Guardrails
entry.summary: Paste your BigQuery query groups (runs per month, GB billed, slot-hours) and see on-demand vs Editions cost, the expensive queries to cap with maximum_bytes_billed, and repeat large scans. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Booking Request Chooser — Which Rental Requests to Accept for the Most Income
entry.summary: Paste your confirmed bookings and pending requests and get the exact set of requests to accept for the highest income, counting turnover cost and the dead gap nights a short stay leaves behind. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.
